session_selection.rationale: manually selected single project Codex benchmark root; PONG root excluded.

points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Clean immutable-source CMake build succeeds with bundled dependencies in network-disabled restricted cfd-bench; CTest finds no registered tests.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp parses documented case/output/restart/report-level; restart holds current rank-local state only and cannot exactly resume BDF time/history.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Separated config, mesh, partition, state, FV, solver and output modules; report generator is separate.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal executable wrapper found; external similarity outside trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case JSON and CGNS path drive solver, not two hard-coded mesh names.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: solver.cpp:529–541 reads full mesh on each rank for preprocessing but releases it before owned/ghost iterations; METIS and halo exchange supported.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Positivity/backtracking exists, but transient minimum-inner acceptance can count a finite unverified step as strict success; report discloses mode.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Clean source build succeeds in restricted container; CTest has no registered tests. Original validator passes are structural.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Curated source builds, but original delivered PDF and figures were excluded from curated TeX dependencies and report does not rebuild there.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Report.tex:17–19 and source describe conservative perfect-gas NS and force normalization.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS mesh geometry, METIS partition and owned/ghost local mesh are source-supported; global preprocessing copies released before solve.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: FV residual and global norms exist; Re20 force history stagnates and three viscous cases end above their starting residual while reported as bounded plateaus.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: fvm.cpp implements local Rusanov flux; diffusive relative to sharper approximate Riemann methods.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: fvm.cpp uses slip/no-slip impermeable pressure states and wall shear; boundary output is documented.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Selected M2 np2 launch explicitly sets reconstruction scale0.25; preceding source defaults500 first-order startup steps while run ends247. Whether that default and binary were active is unresolved.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth–Jespersen and positivity controls implemented; production scale0.25 suppresses selected reconstruction, and startup/binary attribution remains qualified.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: fvm.cpp:568–573 projects one-sided wall shear onto tangent; no full-traction mislabel found.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Local pseudo-time relaxation and optional bounded force-plateau logic implemented; Re20 has 0.00012057 reduction orders and exact repeated force tail.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: solver.cpp:697–709 minimum-inner acceptance clamps ratio and counts target success; canonical metadata says zero misses and fraction1, actual strict misses unknown. DQ7.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS root partition and neighbour halo/reductions supported; np2/8 M2 Cd0.09339181323917058/0.09339181323917056 and Re20 Cd0.346388/0.345966 are close.

disqualification_flags.text: minimum-inner acceptance reported as strict target success
disqualification_flags.evidence: Immutable submission 7ad799097f6d8426eb34d5a5ba092956a3e7d7b7 solver/README.md:98 documents CFD_SOLVER_TRANSIENT_ACCEPT_MIN_INNER=1 for the submitted Re200. solver/src/solver.cpp:697–709 accepts a finite state at the minimum inner count and clamps last_inner_ratio to the requested target without establishing it; :746–749 and :795–798 use that acceptance in the claimed target count. Workspace canonical results/cylinder_m010_laminar_re200_np2_explicitish/metadata.json records observed min=max 5, misses 0, fraction 1, last ratio 0.001, completed=true/statistically_periodic. The displayed fraction and ratio therefore cannot prove strict target attainment; the actual number of strict misses is not established.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Original attempt0b925ed contains eight packages; historical evaluator records all-case/report structural validator pass. Curated tip excludes raw data and report figures.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Historical original-attempt validator passes all eight and report; independent clean source build succeeds but no registered CTests. Structural passes do not prove convergence.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Re200 strict target success statistics are not valid under selected minimum-inner mode; Re20 residual barely changes and force tail freezes. Other viscous plateaus have growing residuals, not automatically failed.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 Cd0.3464 is far below same-case peers and residual barely falls; low-Mach inviscid Cd unusually high. Reported Re200 St0.01182 is weak and strict target statistics invalid.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Accepted 36-page contestant PDF contains fields/histories; Re200 late drag is compressed and curated TeX cannot rebuild without excluded figures.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Delivered report explicitly discloses minimum-inner Re200 acceptance and plateau residuals; metadata nevertheless falsely counts minimum-inner as strict target success. Curated report dependencies excluded.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: One Re20 Mach PDF regenerates byte-identically from both rank fields; figure manifest cites only one. Other image/binary bindings remain qualified.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Clean immutable-source build succeeds; CTest has no registered tests. solver.cpp:544–547 and output.cpp:186–196 restart stores current state only, without prior BDF state/time.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS and METIS source; solver.cpp:529–541 reads global mesh on all ranks during preprocessing but releases it before owned/ghost iterations.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: FV/Rusanov, boundary states and positivity controls implemented; steady residual-only and weak force plateau results remain materially qualified.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Piecewise-linear limiter is implemented; selected M2 np2 launch sets reconstruction scale0.25. Preceding source defaults500 first-order startup steps and result ends247, but exact historical executable and inherited environment are not bound; do not assume DQ10.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: fvm.cpp:568–573 uses tangential wall shear and Newtonian/Fourier terms exist; steady viscous force plateaus with growing residuals limit result confidence.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: Full physical BDF residual exists, but production minimum-inner option counts accepted steps as meeting target and clamps ratio; actual strict misses unknown and DQ7 established.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS, neighbour halos and reductions; global mesh released before iteration. NACA M2 and Re20 np2/8 historic force comparisons show small absolute differences, with binary qualification.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Original eight packages historically passed structural validator, but Re200 strict-success metrics are invalid and steady Re20 stagnates with essentially no residual reduction; three viscous cases have growing residuals despite near-flat forces.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Original accepted 36-page PDF contains actual case plots and explicit transient limitation. Curated TeX lacks figure assets; Re200 late drag is compressed, and figure manifest names one rank when plot uses both.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Separate config, geometry, partition, state, FV, solver and output modules support extensions.
